sentence: Put the phone next to the sink so I can wash my hands.
synonym: Place the phone beside the sink
synonymNote: place beside与put next to意思相同，都表示把东西放在旁边

distractors.word: Throw the phone into the sink
distractors.note: throw into表示扔进去，位置和动作都不对

distractors.word: Hide the phone under the sink
distractors.note: under表示在下面，位置不同，意思改变

distractors.word: Hang the phone above the sink
distractors.note: hang above表示挂在上方，动作和位置都不同
